title: The renderer-web stylesheet fallback checks tailwindcss in node_modules
detail: canResolveTailwindStylesheet looks for tailwindcss in the node_modules directories above the stylesheet, as Tailwind does, instead of asking Bun.resolveSync. On Bun 1.4.4 the resolver auto-installs tailwindcss next to a renderer copy in Bun's install cache, so a build without a node_modules tree took the fallback and then failed in Tailwind with "Can't resolve 'tailwindcss'". Such a build skips the fallback stylesheet again.

title: Package lookups no longer auto-install from the registry
detail: The new @cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime/resolve-installed-package export looks up node_modules before asking Bun.resolveSync, which installs missing packages from the registry since Bun 1.4.4. The prod build, the dev-server stylesheet lookup and the handbuch commands use it.

title: bundledLists sets one table block for every bundled list
detail: composeFeatures takes bundledLists with a table block and an optional pinFirstColumn flag. The block is mixed into every entityList, projectionList and relatedList section of the bundled features, the foundation features user and tenant as well as the features an app mounts from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features, before the boot validator runs. A key the screen sets itself wins, export is left out on relatedList sections, and pinFirstColumn pins the first visible column left where no column is pinned yet. grouping and totals are rejected in the shared block. App screens stay untouched. Features opt in with the new registrar method r.adoptsBundledLists(), which every bundled feature with lists calls and which feature packages such as Enterprise can call for their own lists; app features never do. No migration for apps. The option lives in AppConfig.bundledLists for the managed kumiko/schema.ts and in the run options of runProdApp, runDevApp and runWorkerApp, so kumiko check and the running app see the same screens.

title: Boot database backoff takes an injectable clock
detail: The new databaseWait option on runProdApp and runWorkerApp swaps sleep, now and the log sink of the database, KMS and seed waits. A worker boot against an unreachable database is now tested to retry until the deadline, abort with the connection error and close its Redis clients.

title: Default CSP covers inline scripts of HTML written after the build
detail: At boot the hashes from csp-hashes.json are merged with the inline scripts found in the HTML files under staticDir, for the default CSP and for hostDispatch. Boot-rendered pages keep their inline scripts working without a custom securityHeaders.csp.

title: Read-only demo mode blocks WebSocket upgrades
detail: Upgrade requests count as mutating in the demo read-only gate and get 403 demo_read_only unless the route path is in allowedWritePaths. Socket routes in a read-only demo that need to stay open must be listed there.

title: BootOptionName drops demoMode, seeds and signals
detail: No stack declared them in bootRequires, so their boot checks never ran. A name returns together with its check and a test once a stack needs it.
migration: no known callers; remove "demoMode", "seeds" and "signals" from bootRequires options

title: appOverrides work in runWorkerApp and runDevApp
detail: Both boot functions take the same appOverrides option as runProdApp and share its merge, so worker-rendered mails and the dev server resolve the same tenant model, branding and SEO values as the API. The runSingleInstance:false warning names appOverrides next to mail, fileStorage and featureToggles.

title: Boot seeds survive a short database outage
detail: applyStandardBootSeeds re-runs the idempotent seed sequence with the database backoff on transient connection errors (ECONNREFUSED, connection class 08, too_many_connections) until the 90 second deadline. Non-transient errors still abort the boot at once.

title: filesForTenant in SystemWireDeps
detail: The wire hook and the worker wireComponents receive filesForTenant, built from the AppContext after buildServer wired it. ApiEntrypoint and WorkerEntrypoint expose that context as entrypoint.context.

title: runProdApp split into boot phases, boot steps shared with dev and worker
detail: runProdApp() keeps its signature and behavior. Config resolution, feature composition, dependency connection, request context, auth wiring, entrypoint, seeds and the returned handle now live in run-prod-app-*.ts files next to run-prod-app.ts. Steps that prod, dev and the worker ran as copies (env defaults, feature composition, boot validation, the auth-mfa switch-tenant gate, the tier and feature-toggle resolver, standard boot seeds, shared auth routes, the KMS health gate and the database pools) live once in the new subpath @cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime/boot/shared-boot-steps. requireEnv is still exported from run-prod-app under the same name.

title: runProdApp releases connections when the boot fails
detail: A failing boot closes the database pools, the Redis client and the KMS adapter it already opened. The KMS health wait logs "KMS not reachable" instead of "database not reachable".

title: Boot validation and shutdown hardening
detail: The KMS and app database waits share one deadline so a boot never outlasts the liveness window. An app-supplied master key provider is checked at boot, also in a dry run. Additional fileStorage providers get the same production and S3 checks as the default one, and their env keys are validated. appOverrides without auth or delivery feature abort instead of being dropped. A fatal shutdown keeps its listeners installed, and inline script hashing handles a ">" inside quoted attributes.

title: billing boot option takes stripe and/or dodo
detail: billing.stripe is now optional and billing.dodo is new (priceToTier, oneOffPriceIds). At least one is required. resolveBillingOption returns features (an array) instead of feature, and one webhook route serves every provider on stripe.webhookPath or SUBSCRIPTION_WEBHOOK_PATH. DODO_PAYMENTS_API_KEY and DODO_PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_KEY are the env bridge.
migration: Callers of resolveBillingOption use billing.features instead of billing.feature.

title: Database wait ignores Bun.SQL error codes
detail: The transient connection error list no longer contains the ERR_POSTGRES_* codes of the removed Bun.SQL driver; postgres-js never raises them.

title: hostDispatch pages get the build's CSP script hashes
detail: The deps passed to hostDispatch now carry cspScriptHashes (the inline-script hashes from csp-hashes.json). Build the page CSP with buildDefaultCsp(deps.cspScriptHashes), now exported, so per-host pages keep script-src without unsafe-inline. runDevApp passes an empty list because dev serves no per-host CSP.

title: Production logs are plain JSON without the [runProdApp] prefix
detail: Behavior change for log parsers and alert rules: runProdApp and runWorkerApp now write one JSON object per line from the process logger, without the former "[runProdApp]" text prefix. Match on the component field instead of the prefix.

title: runProdApp requires trustedProxyHops in production
detail: In production runProdApp refuses to boot when neither the trustedProxyHops option, the auth option nor KUMIKO_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS is set. An explicit 0 is allowed. create-kumiko-app templates write KUMIKO_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=0 into .env.example.
migration: set KUMIKO_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=<hops> (0 when the app is exposed directly) or pass trustedProxyHops

title: Fatal-error handlers and graceful server stop
detail: New installFatalErrorHandlers logs uncaughtException and unhandledRejection, stops the app and exits 1 (hard exit after 10 s). runProdApp and runWorkerApp install it. The HTTP server stop is awaited against a 10 s grace period and then forced before the database closes.

title: resolveStoredUserEmail and resolveFeatureTogglesOption exported
detail: resolveStoredUserEmail (with MailRecipientScope) and resolveFeatureTogglesOption with its binding types are available from the package entry. The production boot builds the template resolver API with the registry.

title: diskFileRoute for allowlisted disk files
detail: diskFileRoute({ path, resolveFile }) returns an anonymous GET extra route with a :file parameter. resolveFile maps the raw name to a disk path or null for 404; the file is served with mime type, ETag and 304 handling.

title: effectiveFeatures is gone from runProdApp, runDevApp and runWorkerApp
detail: The effectiveFeatures option of the boot functions is removed. Global operator switches come from the featureToggles option, tier gating from the tier-engine feature, which the boot functions wire themselves.
migration: Replace a hand-built effectiveFeatures resolver with featureToggles true (global switches) and mount createTierEngineFeature for tier gating. A custom resolver that did neither has no replacement on the boot functions; wire it through createKumikoServer or setupTestStack in tests. The boot functions now abort when the option is still passed, because an ignored option would drop an operator kill-switch silently; the same goes for a feature-toggles feature in features without the featureToggles option, or with it set (the option mounts the feature).

title: The default mail resolver only reaches members of the notifying tenant
detail: The default resolveEmail of the mail boot option returns an address for a notification from a tenant other than the system tenant only if the user is a member of that tenant or holds the SystemAdmin role in the stored user row. Everyone else resolves to null and the mail is skipped. The new option mail.recipientScope takes "membership" (default) or "any", which restores the old behaviour of reaching every user. EmailChannelOptions resolveEmail now receives the tenant database as TenantDb instead of unknown.
migration: Apps that notify users outside the notifying tenant on purpose, for example merchants reached from a SystemAdmin context, set mail recipientScope to "any" or keep their own resolveEmail. Apps whose notifications go to members of the active tenant need no change. Known consumers on the default: offlot-app (main.ts) reaches merchants and SystemAdmins across tenants and needs recipientScope any; publicstatus (main.ts), show-pony, solon (main.ts) and kumiko-studio (main.ts) take the default, which fits notifications to members of the active tenant. money-horse and phronexsis keep their own resolveEmail. Per-app resolvers that only copied the membership check can be deleted. A custom resolveEmail that cast ctx.db can drop the cast.

title: runDevApp and runWorkerApp take the declarative boot options
detail: mail, fileStorage, kmsMode, billing, seeds, demoMode, envSchema and featureToggles work in runDevApp, and mail, fileStorage, kmsMode, billing, featureToggles and envSchema in runWorkerApp, through the same resolve functions as runProdApp. The worker honours KUMIKO_DRY_RUN_ENV with an env schema. A stack that sets runSingleInstance false only warns when no worker mounts the features.
migration: RunDevAppOptions.seeds is now `readonly SeedFn[] | RunDevAppSeedsConfig`. Code that spreads `seeds` from an object typed as RunDevAppOptions no longer type-checks; declare that object with `satisfies RunDevAppOptions` so the array type survives, or build the seed list separately. An app that lists createFeatureTogglesFeature() in the features passed to runDevApp or runProdApp removes it there and sets `featureToggles: true`.

title: featureToggles, appOverrides and secrets in boot deps
detail: featureToggles true mounts feature-toggles and layers the global switches over the tier resolver in runProdApp, runDevApp and runWorkerApp. appOverrides sets tenant-model, branding and seo defaults. masterKeyProvider and configEncryption reach extraContext factories, system wiring and seed functions, so an app no longer resolves its KEK a second time.

title: Boot errors for removed and half-wired feature toggles
detail: runProdApp, runDevApp and runWorkerApp abort when the removed effectiveFeatures option is still passed, and when feature-toggles sits in features without the featureToggles option. runWorkerApp now enforces a stack that expects featureToggles, so a worker cannot keep running jobs and event handlers of features an operator switched off.

title: Named S3 provider names are validated at boot
detail: fileStorage.providers refuses the names s3-env, s3 and inmemory, which the bundled providers register, and a name listed twice. A tenant admin can still select any mounted provider through the file-foundation provider config, so name a provider only if every tenant may use its bucket.

title: Named S3 providers and a corrected SMTP_HOST description
detail: fileStorage.providers takes entries with name, envPrefix and lazy, each validated through createS3EnvSchema with its own prefix. The SMTP_HOST description in the env schema of mail smtp-env now says the variable is required.

title: Demo-mode accounts can carry a label
detail: demoMode.notice.accounts entries may be { role, label? } next to a bare role; the GET /demo-mode payload then lists { role, label?, email, password } so the banner can name each login. Bare roles behave as before.

title: Seeds no longer fail on write handlers that declare a rateLimit
detail: The seed dispatcher gets an unlimited RateLimitResolver instead of none; requests keep the app's resolver and limits.

title: Default mail resolveEmail finds users of any tenant
detail: The default resolveEmail of the mail boot option loads the user by id only. Rows in read_users carry the system tenant, so the former tenantId filter returned null for every real tenant.

title: extraContext factories see the boot env, billing hook and new exports
detail: The merged env, including the defaults of declarative boot options such as FILE_STORAGE_PROVIDER from fileStorage, is passed to extraContext factories as env. resolveBillingOption, parseRunMode, HostDispatchFn, buildDemoModeRoute and withDemoReadOnlyFetch are exported from the package index. The billing boot option accepts afterSync.

title: runProdApp requires envSchema
detail: envSchema on runProdApp is no longer optional. Without it the boot throws a KumikoBootError that points to composeEnvSchema. An app without its own variables passes composeEnvSchema({ core: frameworkCoreEnvSchema, features }).
migration: Pass envSchema: composeEnvSchema({ core: frameworkCoreEnvSchema, features }) to runProdApp, with composeEnvSchema from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/env and frameworkCoreEnvSchema from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-dev-server/env-schema. App-level variables go into extend. Delete hand-written env checks that ran before runProdApp; the schema covers them.

title: KUMIKO_DRY_RUN_ENV=boot prints an env table and exits 0 on missing values
detail: The boot dry run lists every variable of the composed schema with its feature, whether it is required, and whether it is set, missing or invalid. DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL and JWT_SECRET appear with source server-runtime when the schema does not declare them, since runProdApp reads them itself. Values are never printed, and a validation message that quotes the value is replaced. A keyring the master-key provider cannot use fails the dry run. An invalid value exits 1. A missing required value exits 0 and says the feature wiring was not validated; with every variable present the dry run validates the wiring as before. NODE_ENV=production does not change this. The MFA secret binding and other env reads run after this exit, so an empty env no longer crashes the dry run.

title: runProdApp names the stack and the boot option it is missing
detail: Features returned by the compose*Stack helpers carry bootRequires ({ stack, options }), a new optional FeatureDefinition field; BootOptionName and StackBootRequirement are exported from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine. runProdApp checks them before it wires the boot options and fails with "[runProdApp] stacks in `features` need boot options that are not set:" followed by one line per gap, for example "composeSaasStack needs the boot option `billing`: set billing: { stripe: { priceToTier }, defaultTier }". composeMailStack and composeUserDataRightsStack need mail (or a mounted channel-email), composeFileStack without providers needs fileStorage (or a mounted file provider), composeGdprStack and composeSecurityStack need kmsMode (or kms / allowPlaintextPii), composeSecurityStack also fails with rateLimit: false, composeSaasStack with billing "stripe" needs billing (or a mounted subscription provider). composeFileStack takes providers as optional now. The renderer, pages, ops and identity stacks need no option. resolveBillingOption is exported from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime/boot-options/billing for tests that mount the billing wiring on a test stack.

title: runProdApp effectiveFeatures is deprecated
detail: effectiveFeatures stays for one release. createTierEngineFeature({ tierMap }), or composeSaasStack, builds the per-tenant feature resolver at boot, and the prod-only features come from the mail, fileStorage and billing options.

title: runProdApp boot options for mail, kmsMode, fileStorage, billing, demoMode, seeds and signals
detail: New optional runProdApp fields replace hand-wired bin/main.ts code. mail ({ transport: "smtp-env" | "inmemory" | EmailTransport, from?, resolveEmail?, tenantTransport? }) mounts channel-email and routes the auth mails through it; needs delivery. kmsMode ("required" | "optional" | { plaintextReason }) builds KMS and blind-index key from PLATFORM_KEK, SUBJECT_KEYS_DATABASE_URL and KUMIKO_BLIND_INDEX_KEY and cannot be combined with kms, blindIndexKey or allowPlaintextPii. fileStorage ({ provider: "s3-env" | "inmemory" | "auto" }) mounts the file provider; auto picks S3 when S3_* is complete and aborts a production boot on a partial S3 env; needs file-foundation. billing ({ stripe: { priceToTier, webhookPath? }, defaultTier }) mounts subscription-stripe and the tier-sync webhook route; needs billing-foundation and tier-engine. demoMode ({ readOnly, notice? }) serves GET /demo-mode and answers writes with 403 demo_read_only while readOnly; demo account credentials are published only when listed in notice.accounts. seeds also takes { demoTenant, demoAdminFromEnv, sysadminFromEnv, run }; the array form still works, but code indexing RunProdAppOptions["seeds"][number] must switch to ProdSeedFn. SIGTERM/SIGINT now run stop() with a 25 s drain timeout (signals: { drainTimeoutMs }) and exit 1 on timeout or error instead of always 0; signals: false hands the signals to the host. The env blocks the options read (SMTP_* for mail smtp-env, S3_* for fileStorage s3-env/auto, the KMS block for kmsMode, STRIPE_* for billing, DEMO_* for the seed shortcuts) join the app's envSchema for the boot dry run and the env validation without the app composing them; keys the option cannot run without (SMTP_HOST, the four S3 keys under s3-env, the seeded accounts) are required there. Without the new fields the boot behaves as before. createSubscriptionTierSync().createWebhookRoute takes an optional { path }. kmsEnvSchema is also exported from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/crypto-shredding/env, which loads without the crypto-shredding feature. Recipe: samples/recipes/prod-boot-options.

title: runProdApp sets a Content-Security-Policy and L1/L2 rate limits without configuration
detail: Without options, runProdApp now sends a default CSP (default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' plus the sha256 hashes of the build's inline scripts; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none') and limits requests per client IP to 600/60 s (L1) and 30/60 s on /api/auth/* (L2). kumiko build writes dist/csp-hashes.json from every HTML file it outputs; without that file the CSP has no hashes and boot warns. securityHeaders.csp takes false (off), a string (replaces the default) or { extend: { directive: [sources] } }. rateLimit: false disables both layers, partial values override only the named fields. Apps with their own CSP set the header through securityHeaders.csp as a string or move their additions to extend; apps that need neither opt out with csp: false and rateLimit: false. Behind a reverse proxy set trustedProxyHops, otherwise all clients share one rate-limit bucket. Details in docs/reference/security-defaults.md.

title: makeSeedCreateFileRef is exported
detail: makeSeedCreateFileRef and the SeedCreateFileRef type are exported from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime, so app seed scripts can create file references the same way the bootstrap seeder does.

title: Bootstrap fails when a global-role invite cannot be provisioned; delivery notify works without auth
detail: runBootstrap now fails with a non-zero exit when an invite with global roles ends role-mismatch or cancelled. The delivery notify factory gets a config resolver also when the app has no auth feature.

title: Seeds can create fileRefs through handlers that use createFileRefFromBytes
detail: The seed dispatcher built its handler context without the file provider resolver, so a write handler invoked via systemWriteAs failed with "createFileRefFromBytes: ctx.files is unavailable". The seed context now carries the same file provider as the HTTP path.

title: composeFeatures adds template-resolver, renderer-foundation and renderer-mail-html for auth apps
detail: With includeBundled, the auth mails are stored templates and the boot seed needs the template-resolver and a mail renderer. composeFeatures adds whichever of template-resolver, renderer-foundation and renderer-mail-html the app does not mount itself, so runDevApp, runProdApp and scaffolds keep booting. Apps without the template tables need a schema migration (`kumiko schema generate`).

title: Immediate notify renders with the tenant config in runProdApp
detail: The boot delivery notify factory passes tenantConfigFor, built from the boot config resolver, to the delivery service, so immediate notifications render the tenant name in the mail layout like the delivery.render job does.

title: composeFeatures no longer warns about auth-self-registration listed in APP_FEATURES
composeFeatures mounts files-tenant-data when files and tenant-lifecycle are present
Boot context passes Redis to the delivery service
detail: notify with an idempotencyKey used to throw because the delivery service had no idempotencyRedis. Production boot, dev boot and the worker boot now hand over the existing Redis.

title: Boot rejects decrypted kms env slots that violate their schema validators
detail:
runProdApp validates Key-Manager-decrypted env slots against their schema
A `kms` slot delivered only as `_CIPHERTEXT` skipped its own `.regex`/`.min`/`.refine` because the first parse relaxes it. After decryption the env is now parsed again, so a malformed plaintext aborts the boot with a `KumikoBootError` naming the slot.

title: Prod static files and the dev server share one request-bound systemQuery wiring
detail:
Shared request-bound systemQuery wiring and clearer deploy scaffold warnings
`@cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime/request-bound-system-query` exports the systemQuery wiring that the prod static-file path and the dev server previously each copied. `scaffoldDeploy` now tells a broken `package.json` (deploy settings fall back to defaults) apart from an unexpected `dependencies`/`workspaces` shape in its warning.

title: runProdApp and runDevApp forward auth.retiredCookieDomains to the auth routes
detail:
runProdApp and runDevApp pass retiredCookieDomains through
`auth.retiredCookieDomains` is now accepted by both runners and reaches the auth routes. Before, the option existed only on the lower-level route config, so apps starting through the runners could not clear a retired cookie domain.

title: runWorkerApp records app.started; instance id prefers KUMIKO_INSTANCE_ID over HOSTNAME
detail:
runWorkerApp records app.started too
The worker now appends the same `kumiko:system:app.started` event as `runProdApp`. The instance id prefers `KUMIKO_INSTANCE_ID` and falls back to `HOSTNAME`, then the OS hostname.

title: runProdApp records an app.started system event with version and instance on every boot
detail:
runProdApp records a `kumiko:system:app.started` event on every boot
Each start appends one event under the system tenant (stream type `app-instance`) with the app version, the instance id (`HOSTNAME`, else the OS hostname) and the start time. Set `KUMIKO_APP_VERSION` and optionally `KUMIKO_GIT_COMMIT` in the deployment; without a version the event records `"unknown"`. A failed write is logged and does not stop the boot. The framework exports `APP_STARTED_EVENT_TYPE` and `APP_INSTANCE_STREAM_TYPE` from `event-store`.

title: Delivery failures are logged to the app logger in prod
detail: The prod and worker boot pass the app logger (`extraContext.log`) to the delivery service, so redacted delivery failures reach that logger instead of the console. `ctx.notify` is built with `createDeliveryNotifyFactory`. `buildBootExtraContext` accepts an optional `log`.

title: masterKey on runProdApp and runWorkerApp replaces the env KEK for the boot checks
detail:
A `masterKey` provider on runProdApp and runWorkerApp is enough for the boot checks
The boot probe for `encrypted: true` entity fields now accepts the cipher the runner builds from `masterKey` (new `ValidateBootOptions.entityFieldCipher`), and the env-schema parse no longer requires `KUMIKO_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY_V1` when `masterKey` is set. The framework exports `withOptionalEnvKeys` for that, and the secrets feature exports `SECRETS_MASTER_KEK_ENV_KEYS`. Without `masterKey`, a missing env KEK still stops the boot; the message now names both ways to provide a key. A malformed env KEK now fails during boot validation, so `KUMIKO_DRY_RUN_ENV=boot` reports it too.
migration: Apps that pass `masterKey` can drop `KUMIKO_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY_V1` from their env and deployment config. Apps without `masterKey` change nothing.

title: Prod seeds get registry and dispatcher
detail:
Prod seeds receive the boot registry and a system dispatcher
`ProdSeedFn` deps grow from `{ db }` to `{ db, registry, dispatcher }`. Seeds should write through `dispatcher.write(...)` so projections and hooks run. The dispatcher is built once when `seeds` or `seedsDir` is set and is shared with the seed migrations.

title: Prod build runs Tailwind in-process instead of spawning the CLI
detail: The prod build runs Tailwind in-process (`@tailwindcss/node` and `@tailwindcss/oxide`, resolved from the `@tailwindcss/cli` package) instead of spawning the CLI. Options mirror the CLI, and a parity test pins byte-identical output.

title: runBootstrap() for one-shot passwordless prod provisioning; runProdApp auth.admin is optional
detail: Creates tenants (seed hook only on creation) and mails invitations; reruns send nothing, expired unused invitations are re-sent. Convention bin/bootstrap.ts -> dist-server/bootstrap.js.

title: runWorkerApp: secrets in wireComponents and a metrics port
detail: WorkerWireDeps carries ctx.secrets (for createInboundMailSupervisor), and the new metrics option serves /metrics on its own port; KUMIKO_DRY_RUN_ENV=boot validates it.

title: Worker metrics server starts before entrypoint.start() and is closed if boot fails
Worker picks up tenant timezone changes made on API pods
detail: The worker boot now joins the cache sync bus, so a timezone write on an API pod invalidates the worker's cached tenant timezone instead of leaving jobs on the old value until the TTL expires.

title: Prod builds no longer inject an inline script for the build info, so strict CSPs without unsafe-inline work without hashes or nonces
detail: Build info is baked into index.html as a meta tag instead of an inline script
migration: window.__KUMIKO_BUILD__ no longer exists. Code that read it (for example a version footer) now gets undefined and silently renders nothing. Replace the global with readLoadedBuild() from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer-web, which returns { id, builtAt } from the new <meta name="kumiko-build"> tag, and drop the Window augmentation for __KUMIKO_BUILD__. The UpdateChecker needs no change.

title: hostDispatch not-found can serve a custom 404 page
detail: `HostDispatchResult` `{ kind: "not-found" }` accepts `file` (relative to `staticDir`) and `csp`. The page goes through the same delivery as `kind: "html"` (page head, `Vary: Host`, CSP) with status 404. A missing file answers 500 with the same message as `html`.

title: boot warning when trustedProxyHops is unset
detail: runProdApp warns at boot when neither `trustedProxyHops` nor `KUMIKO_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS` is set. Behind a reverse proxy all clients then share one IP-keyed rate-limit bucket.
migration: Set `KUMIKO_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS` (for example 1 behind one ingress) or pass `trustedProxyHops` to runProdApp.

title: Client bundle mapping matches exact entry names; page-head HTML is validated by ETag only
detail: Multi-entry client builds map each Bun output to its entry by exact `<base>-<hash>.js` name, so `client-admin` and `client-admin-legacy` can no longer receive each other's bundle. Static HTML with injected page head no longer sends `Last-Modified`, so a crawler sending only `If-Modified-Since` gets the fresh metadata instead of a stale 304.

title: server-runtime and dev-server declare their renderer-web dependency and their .d.ts resolve Bun and Temporal types without consumer setup
detail: The emitted declarations that mention `Temporal` or `Bun` now carry a preserved `/// <reference types>` for `temporal-polyfill/global` and `bun-types`, so a consumer without `bun-types` in its tsconfig no longer gets unresolved `Temporal`/`Bun` errors from our declarations. `kumiko-server-runtime` and `kumiko-dev-server` declare `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer-web` as a dependency (they resolve its `styles.css`; it was already installed through bundled-features) and `bun-types` as a dependency. `bundled-features`, `server-runtime`, `dev-server`, `dispatcher-live`, `headless`, `renderer`, `renderer-web` and `cli` ship the README.md their `files` list already named. `bun run check:dist` now typechecks the packed install, checks README shipping, runtime-resolved package declarations and the `styles.css` resolve.

title: Production build copies the renderer-web fonts
detail: `buildProdBundle` copies the IBM Plex woff2 files to `dist/assets/kumiko/fonts/`, where the compiled CSS expects them. The new export `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime/renderer-web-fonts` holds the URL prefix, the file name allowlist and the resolver, and the woff2 MIME type is known to the static file server.

title: buildProdBundle takes client entries explicitly via package.json "kumiko.clientEntries"/"kumiko.clientEntry" — no more filename inference
detail:
`discoverClientEntries(cwd)`, which scanned `src/` for
`client-<suffix>.tsx` files and treated every match as its own bundle
entry, is replaced by `resolveClientEntries(cwd, declared)` plus
`readClientEntriesConfig(cwd)`, a boundary parser for package.json
`kumiko.clientEntry` / `kumiko.clientEntries`. `buildProdBundle(options)`
now accepts the same `clientEntry`/`clientEntries` shape directly.

`kumiko.clientEntries` entries are validated: `name` must match
`^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` (it becomes the output filename), `sourceFile` (and
`htmlPath`, if set) must resolve inside the app root, `sourceFile` must
exist, and names/html-output-files/source-basenames must be unique
across the list. `clientEntry` and `clientEntries` are mutually
exclusive; an empty `clientEntries` array is rejected (omit the key
instead). Apps with only `src/client.tsx` or `src/client.ts` need no
declaration — that convention is unchanged.

title: runProdApp wires auth-email-password's new invite-info query into invite.infoHandler
detail: When the invite feature is enabled, runProdApp now passes AuthQueries.inviteInfo as invite.infoHandler, mounting POST /auth/invite-info automatically.
migration: No action needed: purely additive wiring, no option changes.

title: runProdApp's KUMIKO_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS parsing now shares framework's parseTrustedProxyHopsEnv
detail:
The inline digits-only + non-negative-integer validation moved out of
`run-prod-app.ts` into `parseTrustedProxyHopsEnv`
(`@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/api`); same validation and error message
as before, no behavioral change.

title: ProdAppHandle.fetch's type now declares its optional socket-address parameter
detail:
`fetch: (req: Request, socketAddress?: string) => Promise<Response> |
Response`. The doc comment now explains that an app with `autoListen:
false` running its own `Bun.serve` must pass
`server.requestIP(req)?.address`, extracted at the outermost Bun fetch
callback — `requestIP()` only resolves for Bun's original Request
instance, not a cloned/rebuilt one. `RunProdAppAuthOptions
.trustedProxyHops`'s doc comment also dropped the stale "pre-#1539
spoofable default" wording; 0 hops is the safe socket-only default.
migration:
No action needed for the default `autoListen: true` boot. Apps with
`autoListen: false` can now type-check passing the socket address to
`handle.fetch`; passing nothing keeps the previous (unresolved) behavior.

title: runProdApp threads the Bun socket address and a trustedProxyHops option through to the client-IP resolver
detail:
`buildBunServeOptions` now extracts the client socket address once via
`server.requestIP(req)` at the outermost Bun.serve fetch callback (a
cloned/rebuilt Request loses that ability) and threads it through
`tryHonoFirst`/`withSecurityHeaders`/`buildStaticFallback` as Hono's
`env`. `RunProdAppOptions` gained a top-level `trustedProxyHops` (falls
back to the deprecated `auth.trustedProxyHops`, then
`KUMIKO_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS`), forwarded into `buildServer` and the
static-fallback's own client-IP resolver.
migration:
Same as the framework entry — set `trustedProxyHops` on `runProdApp` when
deployed behind a reverse-proxy/ingress.

title: Static fallback no longer injects __KUMIKO_SCHEMA__ into HTML
migration:
`HostDispatchResult.injectSchema` is deprecated and ignored — HTML never
carries the schema anymore, in prod or dev. `createKumikoApp` now fetches
the schema itself from the authenticated `GET /api/schema` after its
clientFeature gates (e.g. an auth gate) let rendering through, so a
signed-in admin app keeps working without changes. Anything that read
`window.__KUMIKO_SCHEMA__` directly (custom clients, e2e fixtures) must
switch to fetching `/api/schema` instead. An anonymously reachable page
that used to render schema-based screens needs `createPublicSurface`,
which never carries a schema. The `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime/inject-schema`
subpath export is removed.

title: requireEnv is now part of the public package export
detail:
`packages/server-runtime/src/index.ts` now re-exports `requireEnv`
alongside `runProdApp`, so `import { requireEnv } from
"@cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime"` resolves without reaching into the
internal `run-prod-app.ts` module.

title: resolveAuthMail builds locale-aware appUrls and adds a dedicated auth.mail.hmacSecret
detail:
resolveAuthMail (shared by runProdApp and runDevApp) now builds the passwordReset/emailVerification/signup/invite appUrl from a locale-aware AuthPath, so a function-valued auth.mail.paths entry produces a locale-aware appUrl for every flow, symmetric to the appUrl-as-function support each flow's options already had.
AuthMailOptions also gains an optional hmacSecret: when set, passwordReset/emailVerification tokens sign with it instead of the hmacSecret resolveAuthMail is called with (JWT_SECRET), so JWT_SECRET can rotate without invalidating in-flight reset/verify tokens. hmacSecret is now optional on the passwordReset/emailVerification wrapper options too — an app overriding just appUrl no longer has to also thread its own secret; resolveAuthMail backfills the resolved secret onto that explicit block. An explicitly supplied hmacSecret still wins.

title: ExtraRoutesSystemDeps renamed to SystemWireDeps; hostDispatch gains systemQuery
migration: ExtraRoutesSystemDeps is renamed to SystemWireDeps and now backs the new wire hook instead of extraRoutes; WorkerWireDeps is derived from it. A consumer importing ExtraRoutesSystemDeps from server-runtime must switch to SystemWireDeps (same shape: db, redis, registry, dispatchSystemWrite). HostDispatchFn passed to runProdApp now takes a second argument { systemQuery } - a dispatch function reading db directly for routing decisions must switch to systemQuery.

title: runProdApp, runDevApp and runWorkerApp forward validateBootOptions to validateBoot (fw#3080)
detail: All three run-app entrypoints called `validateBoot(features)` without options, so only `createApp` could pass a `navAllowlist` or `warnOnUniqueAccessRoles` through. An app could declare the option, test it against `validateBoot` directly and see green — while the process it actually boots never received it. The three option types now carry an optional `validateBootOptions`, passed straight through in the same shape `createApp` already uses. `ValidateBootOptions` is exported from `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine` so consumers can type the value. Omitting it leaves boot behaviour unchanged.

title: PageHeadMeta/PageHeadResolver/PageHeadSystemQuery now importable from the server-runtime barrel
detail: The three resolvePageHead types moved to @cosmicdrift/kumiko-headless/apex (kumiko-framework#3026) and are re-exported unchanged from run-prod-app.ts, so the existing @cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime/run-prod-app subpath import keeps working. New: the main @cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime barrel now also exports all three, closing the gap where a consumer had to use the subpath just to type a resolver. render-head-tags.ts (internal-only, not a public subpath) is removed; injectPageHead now lives in headless.

title: runProdApp gains resolvePageHead for per-request Open-Graph/title/description metadata
detail: New PageHeadResolver/PageHeadMeta types and a resolvePageHead option on RunProdAppOptions. buildStaticFallback's static-files module resolves the metadata on both HTML-serving paths (hostDispatch and the default index.html), timing the resolver out at 300ms via Promise.race and always falling back to the unchanged 200 shell on error/null/timeout. Head tags render via renderApexHeadTags from the new @cosmicdrift/kumiko-headless dependency (ApexHead built from PageHeadMeta, lang derived from meta.locale's language subtag, default "en"; og:type is hardcoded "website" by the renderer, so PageHeadMeta has no ogType field), injected idempotently via a marker comment in render-head-tags.ts's injectPageHead, same pattern as inject-schema.ts. A strong ETag is recomputed over the final bytes whenever head tags are actually injected, so two requests with different resolved metadata never collide on one ETag. systemQuery inside the resolver dispatches as createAnonymousUser (not createSystemUser) wrapped in requestContext.run, using the new buildRequestContextDataFromRequest(req: Request) extracted from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/api's existing buildRequestContextData(c: Context) — needed because this resolver runs outside Hono's router and only has a raw Request. No behavior change for apps that don't set resolvePageHead.
